label: 4. It was so late in the evening that

lines.text: Unlocks: Clear event stage 103020112 · After The Citizens chat 3. Everything good on your end, everyone?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: It was so late in the evening that

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: we never had the chance to have proper goodbyes,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: but great job, everyone.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Thanks for helping out!

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: You all did fantastic.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You guys worked just as hard.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: It was fun!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Glad we were of good assistance.
I'm just glad nothing serious happened.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Likewise.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Sure, there was a minor incident,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: but it was all resolved peacefully.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: These people have remarkable stamina.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I don't know how they're able to stay up all night like this.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's the power of youth, my friend.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hey, it's not like we're old fogies just yet!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I'm just saying.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: I wanted to let the Counters and the Commander know

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: just how much we appreciate you helping us out.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: If you need us for anything in the future,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: you can call on us anytime.
Noted.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I know this was technically a job,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: but I had a lot of fun, and I'm sure everyone else did too.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: For sure.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Next time, we should ditch the work aspect

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: and just have all of us hang out and have fun.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: That's a great idea!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Agreed.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Anyway,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: we all pretty much pulled an all-nighter,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: so get some well-deserved rest, everyone.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Also, Halloween isn't over just yet,

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: so you've still got time to enjoy a few other events if you're up for it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I think I'll do just that!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... After a few hours of shuteye, of course.
Me too.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Okay, sleep well.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: We're going to get some sleep too, aren't we, Poli?

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: We should do our utmost not to deviate from our usual sleep schedule.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Mhmm!
